bugs.name: Comma-separated attribute value names are saved as one combined value
bugs.summary: The Add Value dialog claims comma-separated input adds several values, but saving “Bronze, Silver, Gold” creates one combined attribute value.
bugs.expected: The comma-separated input should create three values: Bronze, Silver, and Gold.
bugs.actual: The values list showed one row with slug “bronze-silver-gold” and label “Bronze, Silver, Gold”. The single row remained after refreshing the page.
reproSteps: Open /attributes/ using the preloaded saved admin authentication state; the dashboard shows the signed-in admin as admin@example.com.

Choose Create attribute. Enter the fresh default label “Momentic Comma Attribute 9f73c2” and code “momentic-comma-attribute-9f73c2”; leave the input type as Dropdown and select Customer Attribute, then save.
On the created attribute detail page, choose Assign value. Observe the dialog help text promising that a comma-separated list adds several values at once.
Enter “Bronze, Silver, Gold” in Name and save.
Inspect Attribute Values: the list shows a single row with label “Bronze, Silver, Gold” and slug “bronze-silver-gold”. Refresh the page and confirm the same single row remains.

bugs.name: The customer attribute value deletion warning refers to products, although the attribute is a Customer Attribute.
bugs.summary: The customer attribute value deletion warning refers to products, although the attribute is a Customer Attribute.
bugs.expected: The confirmation warning should identify the kinds of records relevant to a Customer Attribute rather than referring to products.
bugs.actual: The dialog says the value can no longer be assigned to products with the “QA Validation Only” attribute, despite the page identifying it as a Customer Attribute.
reproSteps: /attributes/
Sign in to the Saleor Dashboard as the admin account.
Open Attributes and create or open a Customer Attribute that has an assigned value.
Choose the delete control for one of that attribute's values to display the confirmation dialog.

bugs.name: Product attributes filter loses PRODUCT_TYPE scope when changing the filter field
bugs.summary: The Product attributes view returns Customer and Model attribute rows after applying Filterable in Storefront = Yes, and the mixed results persist after refresh.
bugs.expected: Applying the Filterable in Storefront = Yes filter in the Product attributes view should keep the list scoped to Product Attribute rows.
bugs.actual: After Apply, the grid included Customer Attribute and Model Attribute rows while the selector still displayed Product attributes. The URL no longer included the PRODUCT_TYPE condition, and the mixed results remained after refresh.
reproSteps: Open Filters; the existing condition is Type is Product type.
Change the condition field to Filterable in Storefront, keep the operator as is, select Yes, and click Apply.

Inspect the grid while the view selector still says Product attributes. Customer Attribute and Model Attribute rows appear alongside Product Attribute rows. The resulting URL is /attributes/?0%5Bs0.filterableInStorefront%5D=true&activeTab=1&sort=name&asc=true.
Refresh and verify that the mixed attribute types remain in the Product attributes view.

bugs.name: Saving a Numeric Product Attribute turns off Filterable in storefront
bugs.summary: Creating a Numeric Product Attribute with “Filterable in storefront” visibly enabled silently saves it disabled; the off state persists after refresh.
bugs.expected: The saved Product Attribute should retain the enabled “Filterable in storefront” setting selected on the creation form, unless the interface communicates that Numeric configuration will change it.
bugs.actual: The creation form showed “Filterable in storefront” enabled and the setting was left unchanged. After a successful save, the detail page showed the property disabled; it remained disabled after refresh. No explanation that Numeric settings override this property was shown.
reproSteps: Use the authenticated admin session for admin@example.com (loaded from the provided saved session; no credentials were entered) and open /attributes/add?type=PRODUCT_TYPE.
Create a fresh Product Attribute with label “Momentic Filter Retention Check 845173” and code “momentic_filter_retention_check_845173”.
Set Catalog Input type to Numeric, enable Select unit, choose Metric for System, Weight for Units of, and kg for Unit. Leave the initially enabled “Filterable in storefront” setting unchanged.
Click Save and inspect the Properties section on the created attribute. Refresh the page and verify the property remains disabled.

bugs.name: Channel attribute filter leaves the broad attribute list visible
bugs.summary: Applying Channel-USD retains the selected channel in the filter panel but leaves the broad All attribute list visible after refresh.
bugs.expected: Applying Channel-USD should have a clear effect on the displayed attribute list so users can distinguish channel-filtered results.
bugs.actual: The filter panel showed Channel is Channel-USD, while the URL became /attributes/?0%5Bs0.attributeType%5D=PRODUCT_TYPE&1=AND&2%5Bs0.channel%5D=default-channel&activeTab=1&sort=name&asc=true. The All tab remained selected and broad rows including Audio quality, Brand, Care Instructions, Certification, and Color remained visible. Reopening the panel showed Channel-USD; after refreshing, the URL, retained selection, and broad list were unchanged.
reproSteps: As a signed-in admin using the supplied authenticated session, open /attributes/?0%5Bs0.attributeType%5D=PRODUCT_TYPE&activeTab=1&asc=true&sort=name.
Open Filters, choose Add condition, select Channel as the condition, and select Channel-USD as its value.
Click Apply. Observe the URL contains 2%5Bs0.channel%5D=default-channel and the broad All list shows rows such as Audio quality, Brand, Care Instructions, Certification, and Color.
Reopen Filters and verify the retained condition reads Channel is Channel-USD.
Refresh the page, wait for it to settle, and verify that the URL still contains default-channel and the broad All list remains visible; reopen Filters and verify Channel-USD is still selected.

matchingGuidance.acceptanceScope: Channel-USD can legitimately have the slug default-channel; that URL token is not a wrong-channel defect. Acceptance is limited to the filter-result UX claim, whose correctness still depends on channel/filter semantics.
prerequisites: Displayed Channel-USD has slug default-channel; attributes may be globally defined.
